decisions.reason: The outer letter in the literal field opens with a single quotation mark at s0074 and closes at s0106. Chinese 陳舞復傳語云：'不孝那！ opens a nested rebuke, so the inner English mark must be a double quote. The present opening already uses that nested double quote; changing it to a single quote would close or collide with the outer letter. Words are already accurate.

The outer letter in the idiomatic field opens with a double quotation mark at s0074 and closes at s0106. Chinese 陳舞復傳語云：'不孝那！ begins a nested rebuke that continues through s0097, so the inner opening must be a single quote. The proposed change supplies that nested opening and does not alter wording.

The nested rebuke that opened at s0096 continues through 天與汝酒飲，不肯飲，中有惡物邪？ and ends before s0098 遂可飲二升. The idiomatic outer letter is double-quoted, so a single closing quote on this unit is the correct nested closer. Wording is unchanged.
